judged_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:52 — P1, confidence medium: `isAttendee = booking.attendees.find(attendee => attendee.email === user.email)` authorizes based on matching the authenticated user's own account email against a booking attendee record; if any account-creation or OAuth linking path in this codebase allows a user to set/claim an unverified email address on their own user record, an attacker can self-register with a victim's known email (e.g. a booking attendee's address) and pass this check to add arbitrary guests and trigger calendar-invite emails on someone else's booking. adjudication.rationale: The new `addGuestsHandler` does authorize a caller as an attendee solely via `const isAttendee = !!booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email);` and there is no check in this handler that `ctx.user.email` is verified/confirmed before treating it as an authorization credential. However, the finding’s exploitability depends on whether the broader codebase allows users to set/claim unverified emails on their account—something not shown in this diff—so this is a concrete, diff-grounded security/authorization concern but not a definitively verifiable vulnerability from the diff alone.
